findings.summary: PBR transmission activation repeated the same four-part linear-image-processing predicate; it now derives the predicate once and reuses it for the renderer and material feature decisions
Runtime mesh-feature expansion used repeated array scans while already modeling a unique set; it now adds the feature lattice directly to the insertion-ordered Set
The shared frame conductor gave its measured delta override a default even though both scene backends provide the parsed value explicitly; the parameter is now required at the shared boundary
